checks.explanation: The selection disclosure is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services line is priced at $2,195 but has no includesText describing covered services, so the condition for this check is not met.
The list shows only the basic services fee as overhead; no second mandatory fee for staff, facilities, or handling appears.
The embalming disclosure is on page 1 and the embalming price is also on page 1, so it is in the same-page placement allowed.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing.
No alternative-container disclosure is transcribed in the list, so the placement condition for this check is not met.
Direct cremation is offered with an option using a container provided by the purchaser, and no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation description lists what is included and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation, and immediate burial each have their own prices, and no goods or services appear only inside a package or policy.
The list contains only itemized offerings and required single-price items; no optional package combination is present.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the wording of the required disclosures.
No text claims that goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no disclosure is printed in a way that is hard to notice.
